practice.input: See a prospective tenant and agent in a street-facing apartment, then hear one complete, natural Korean conversation.
practice.output: Compare light and noise, qualify a preference, and politely request another viewing and a cost detail.
practice.dings: One start cue and one end cue around the finished card

card.title: A Second Look at the Apartment
card.situation: During an apartment viewing, a prospective tenant likes the light but worries about traffic noise and arranges to revisit at a busier hour.
card.description: Weigh a home's advantages against a concern and ask to check it again before deciding.
card.scene: A bright apartment living room beside a road; the agent and prospective tenant stand near a closed window.
card.learnerInput: A visible apartment window and road; eight spoken turns between an unfamiliar adult tenant and agent in polite everyday Korean.
card.expectedOutput: Explain a qualified preference, ask to revisit at a relevant time, and request the maintenance-fee details without committing yet.
card.relationshipAndRegister: Unfamiliar adult prospective tenant and real-estate agent; polite 해요체, natural subject omission.
card.targetConstruction: Positive feature + concern + reason, followed by a tactful alternative and conditional next step.
card.retainedCore: The tenant evaluates the same home rather than switching topics or listing abstract housing vocabulary.
card.variationOpportunity: Change the concern from road noise to insufficient daylight in the inner room while keeping the polite request for a second viewing.
card.independentProductionPrompt: Without seeing the model, tell the agent that the inner room is quiet but dark and ask to view it once more in daylight.

speakerRoles.voiceCharacter: Observant, interested, and cautious without sounding accusatory

lines.speaker: seongho
lines.ko: 거실이 남향이라 낮에는 볕이 꽤 잘 들어요.
lines.en: The living room faces south, so it gets quite a bit of sun during the day.

lines.speaker: hyejin
lines.ko: 밝은 건 좋은데, 창문을 닫아도 도로 소리가 들리네요.
lines.en: I like how bright it is, but I can still hear the road with the window closed.

lines.speaker: seongho
lines.ko: 퇴근 시간엔 차가 좀 몰려요. 안쪽 방은 훨씬 조용한 편이고요.
lines.en: Traffic picks up around rush hour. The inner room is much quieter, though.

lines.speaker: hyejin
lines.ko: 잠은 안쪽 방에서 자겠지만, 집에서 일할 땐 거실도 쓰거든요.
lines.en: I'd sleep in the inner room, but I use the living room when I work from home too.

lines.speaker: seongho
lines.ko: 그러면 시간대를 바꿔서 다시 보시는 게 낫겠네요. 오늘 저녁도 가능해요.
lines.en: Then it would be better to see it again at a different time. This evening works too.

lines.speaker: hyejin
lines.ko: 좋아요. 그때 소음이 괜찮으면 관리비 내역도 같이 볼 수 있을까요?
lines.en: Sounds good. If the noise is okay then, could I also look over the maintenance-fee details?

lines.speaker: seongho
lines.ko: 네, 최근 내역 준비해 둘게요. 몇 시쯤 편하세요?
lines.en: Of course. I'll have the recent details ready. What time works for you?

lines.speaker: hyejin
lines.ko: 일곱 시쯤요. 그때 다시 보고 결정할게요.
lines.en: Around seven. I'll take another look then and decide.

variationPrompt.en: The inner room is quiet but too dark. Ask to see it once more in daylight before deciding.
variationPrompt.ko: 안쪽 방은 조용하지만 너무 어두워요. 결정하기 전에 낮에 한 번 더 보고 싶다고 말해 보세요.
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: 안쪽 방은 조용한데 좀 어둡네요. 낮에 다시 한번 볼 수 있을까요?

card.artworkBrief: Natural contemporary Korean apartment viewing. A woman prospective tenant and male agent by a closed living-room window, warm afternoon light, visible roadway outside. No signage, text, or logos.
